title: Review verdict
description: The reviewer's result for one review round. The runner merges only the exact commit in reviewed_head, and only after verdict pass.

verdict.description: pass: no blocker or major findings and every criterion met; you changed nothing. fixed: you found blocker/major problems, fixed them, committed and pushed. needs_owner: a decision only the owner can make blocks this PR (fill question).

reviewed_head.description: The full 40-character commit you reviewed (the head given in your prompt).

evidence.description: The test or file:line that proves it. 'not_met' only with verdict needs_owner.

problem.description: What is wrong and how you know (the failing case, expected vs actual).

fix.description: What you changed, or what should change.
